hunks.baseline: Of course, there are exceptions to everything.
hunks.sol: Of course, there are exceptions.

hunks.baseline: There are Trolls that can put even a shattered head back together, and Golems that won’t fall until you destroy the core somewhere inside their bodies.
hunks.sol: Some Trolls can put even a shattered head back together. Golems won’t fall until you destroy the core hidden somewhere inside them.

hunks.baseline: But as far as I knew, there wasn’t a single Lycanthrope anywhere that could survive having its head cut off.
hunks.sol: But as far as I knew, there wasn’t a Lycanthrope anywhere that could survive having its head cut off.

hunks.baseline: Not even one that was an S-rank monster and had earned the title of Champion as the strongest warrior of its kind.
hunks.sol: Not even an S-rank monster that had earned the title of Champion as the strongest warrior of its kind.

hunks.baseline: “I’ve arrived! Jin Sama!”
hunks.sol: “I’m here, Jin Sama!”

hunks.baseline: I looked back and forth between Yamamoto Genji, who was chattering so loudly he was spitting, and the headless body of the EXP… No, the Lycanthrope Champion.
hunks.sol: I looked back and forth between Yamamoto Genji, who was talking so excitedly he was spitting, and the headless body of my EXP… No, the Lycanthrope Champion.

hunks.baseline: It had been the perfect time to level up. The meal was already laid out in front of me, and some bastard had swooped in and gobbled it all up.
hunks.sol: It had been the perfect time to level up. The meal was already laid out in front of me, and some bastard had swooped in and gobbled it up.

hunks.baseline: I was so furious, it felt like my hands and feet might start shaking.
hunks.sol: I was so furious my hands and feet felt ready to shake.

hunks.baseline: With my condition already this bad, the anger made my vision blur for a moment.
hunks.sol: I was already in bad shape, and the anger made my vision blur for a moment.

hunks.baseline: If things had gone as I’d calculated, I’d have leveled up by now and recovered completely. But since it had come to this, I had no choice but to use another method.
hunks.sol: If things had gone as I’d calculated, I’d have leveled up by now and recovered completely. Since that hadn’t happened, I had no choice but to use another method.

hunks.baseline: “Um? Jin Sama, are you feeling unwell?”
hunks.sol: “Uh? Jin Sama, is something wrong?”

hunks.baseline: “Does this look like I’m feeling fine, you fucking idiot?”
hunks.sol: “Do I look like I’m all right, you fucking idiot?”

hunks.baseline: I shut Yamamoto Genji up with a single remark, then muttered to myself.
hunks.sol: That shut Yamamoto Genji up. I gave the command in my head.

hunks.baseline: The System manifested in response to the command.
hunks.sol: The System responded.

hunks.baseline: The moment my trembling fingers touched something cold, a clear chime unlike the earlier ones rang out.
hunks.sol: The moment my trembling fingers touched something cold, a clear chime rang out, different from the earlier ones.

hunks.baseline: As the chimes rang one after another, my vision cleared and the convulsions stopped.
hunks.sol: As the chimes rang one after another, my vision cleared and the shaking stopped.

hunks.baseline: The Myriad-Poison Ring had drawn in the poison spreading from around my collarbone throughout my body. It gleamed with its usual black light.
hunks.sol: The Myriad-Poison Ring had drawn in the poison spreading from my collarbone through the rest of my body. It gleamed with its familiar black light.

hunks.baseline: *I may not have leveled up, but at least I had the Myriad-Poison Ring. Thank God for that.*
hunks.sol: *I didn’t level up, but thank God I had the Myriad-Poison Ring.*

hunks.baseline: It was a good thing I’d ended the fight quickly. The venom the Manticore Lord had carried was truly terrifying.
hunks.sol: It was a good thing I’d ended the fight quickly. The Manticore Lord’s venom was terrifying.

hunks.baseline: With Scorching Yang Qi, which was the natural enemy of poison, and a top-grade potion, I could have been cured without much difficulty. But a potion ultimately worked by paying in advance with the body’s energy and vitality to maximize its recovery.
hunks.sol: Scorching Yang Qi was the natural enemy of poison, and with a top-grade potion on top of that, I could have cured myself easily enough. But potions maximized the body’s ability to recover by drawing on its stamina and vitality up front.

hunks.baseline: In a situation like this, with so many enemies left, leveling up—with none of the risk—would have been a hundred times better.
hunks.sol: With so many enemies still out there, a risk-free level-up would have been a hundred times better.

hunks.baseline: Some bastard had been hanging back, watching for an opening, then rushed in and stole the last hit from me.
hunks.sol: That was out of the question, thanks to a certain bastard who’d hung back watching for an opening, then rushed in to steal the last hit.

hunks.baseline: “Forget it. Don’t worry about it.”
hunks.sol: “Forget it. Don’t worry about me.”

hunks.baseline: The bus had already left, and I didn’t have time to stand at an empty bus stop waiting for the next one and slap Yamamoto Genji across the face.
hunks.sol: The bus had already left. I didn’t have time to stand at an empty bus stop waiting for the next one while slapping Yamamoto Genji across the face.

hunks.baseline: The one bit of good news amid all the bad was that the Skeleton King was the kind of excellent monster who knew how to finish his assigned job on time.
hunks.sol: The one bit of good news was that the Skeleton King was an excellent monster who knew how to finish his assigned job on time.

hunks.baseline: We’d gotten quite far apart while fighting our respective opponents, but I could clearly see—and hear—the Death Knight, well over two meters tall, crumple along with his armor.
hunks.sol: We’d gotten quite far apart while fighting our respective opponents, but I could clearly see—and hear—the Death Knight, well over two meters tall, crumple inside its armor.

hunks.baseline: His final scream came with it.
hunks.sol: I heard its final scream, too.

hunks.baseline: Black mist poured out from beneath the helmet pulled low over his face. The Skeleton King seemed to absorb the Death Knight’s soul as it spilled out just before Erasure. Then he grinned at me as I approached using qinggong.
hunks.sol: Black mist flowed out from beneath the helmet pulled low over its face. The Skeleton King absorbed the Death Knight’s soul as it escaped just before Erasure, as though sucking it in. Then he grinned at me as I approached using qinggong.

hunks.baseline: Then he spotted Yamamoto Genji tucked under my arm like a piece of luggage and added, “That fucking bastard.”
hunks.sol: He spotted Yamamoto Genji tucked under my arm like a piece of luggage and added, “That fucking bastard.”

hunks.baseline: I agreed. If that little shit had even slowed the Lycanthrope Champion down for a moment, everything would’ve ended much more smoothly.
hunks.sol: I agreed. If that little shit had held up the Lycanthrope Champion for even a moment, everything would’ve ended much more smoothly.

hunks.baseline: But kicking Yamamoto Genji in the joints in the middle of a battle involving thousands—tens of thousands—of fighters would be something only a lunatic would do. If I had time for that, I needed to use it to save one more person.
hunks.sol: But only a lunatic would stop to kick Yamamoto Genji in the shins in the middle of a battle involving thousands—tens of thousands—of fighters. If I had time for that, I needed to spend it saving someone.

hunks.baseline: With that brief word, I shot forward. My limbs creaked, proof of the fierce battle that had just taken place, and my internal energy was considerably depleted.
hunks.sol: With that, I shot forward. My limbs creaked from the fierce fight I’d just been through, and I’d used up a considerable amount of internal energy.

hunks.baseline: The spearhead of White Flame, sent flying with tremendous force, swept through the rear of the monster army swarming like ants.
hunks.sol: I hurled White Flame with all my strength. Its spearhead swept through the rear of the monster army swarming like ants.

hunks.baseline: A muffled boom swallowed the screams, and the flames that erupted in an instant burned the limbs off the living monsters.
hunks.sol: A muffled boom swallowed their screams, and flames burst out, burning the living monsters’ limbs.

hunks.baseline: *One more time.*
hunks.sol: *One more.*

hunks.baseline: A thunderous crack split across the desert.
hunks.sol: A thunderous crack split the desert.

hunks.baseline: The spear didn’t carry the same internal energy as the first one, but its spearhead still held all that terrible force and speed—enough to pierce dozens of monsters with ease.
hunks.sol: The spear didn’t carry as much internal energy as the first, but the sheer force and speed behind its spearhead were enough to pierce dozens of monsters.

hunks.baseline: Even a glancing blow burst their heads like watermelons, sending severed limbs flying into the air.
hunks.sol: Even a glancing blow burst heads like watermelons and sent severed limbs flying.

hunks.baseline: I could feel the monster army, which had seemed like it would never grow smaller no matter how many I killed, falter.
hunks.sol: The monster army, which had seemed as though it would never shrink no matter how many I killed, began to falter.

hunks.baseline: By the time I hurled my spear for the third time, hundreds had already fallen. I kicked off the air and soared upward, then flung Yamamoto Genji from under my arm toward the ground and reached out.
hunks.sol: By the time I hurled a third spear, hundreds had already fallen. I kicked off the air and soared upward, flung Yamamoto Genji from under my arm toward the ground, and reached out.
*Shweee! Snap!*

hunks.baseline: White Flame came flying in response to the call through my Middle Dantian and landed in my hand with a snap.
hunks.sol: White Flame answered my call through the Middle Dantian and flew into my hand.

hunks.baseline: Somehow, its familiar grip had become so natural that I could recognize it without even looking.
hunks.sol: Its grip had become so familiar that I could recognize it without looking.

hunks.baseline: As soon as I reclaimed it, I poured in Scorching Yang Qi. The transparent spearhead took on a reddish glow.
hunks.sol: As soon as I caught it, I poured in Scorching Yang Qi. The transparent spearhead took on a reddish glow.

hunks.baseline: And… the eyes staring blankly at me as I soared through the air, with the entire battlefield laid out below.
hunks.sol: And… eyes staring blankly up at me as I soared above the battlefield.

hunks.baseline: The wind brushed across my body. Time, which had stopped, gradually returned to its usual pace.
hunks.sol: Wind brushed across my body. Time, which had seemed to stop, gradually resumed its usual pace.

hunks.baseline: I saw conflicting emotions surface in countless eyes that had opened wide.
hunks.sol: I saw opposite emotions appear in countless wide eyes.

hunks.baseline: There was joy in some. In others, despair was slowly sinking into reality.
hunks.sol: Joy in some. In others, despair slowly setting in.

hunks.baseline: Which of the two opposing species was rejoicing and which was despairing? No one here needed to say it.
hunks.sol: No one there needed to be told which side felt which.

hunks.baseline: *Fire Dragon Divine Spear. This form.*
hunks.sol: *Fire Dragon Divine Spear. Second form.*

hunks.baseline: My body descended slowly, keeping pace with time as I perceived it, while the flame-filled spearhead rose high, as if to pierce the sky.
hunks.sol: My body descended slowly, keeping pace with time as I perceived it, while I raised the flame-wreathed spearhead high enough to pierce the sky.

hunks.baseline: At that moment, when the space around me warped under the extreme heat, a massive shadow that had been circling over the Hunters surrounded by monsters shot toward me.
hunks.sol: As the extreme heat warped the air, a massive shadow that had been circling above the surrounded Hunters shot toward me.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, I could sense it without looking. Unlike the other monsters, it was flying toward me like a streak of light. The gale raised by a single flap of its wings carried immense magical power.
hunks.sol: I didn’t have to look to sense its approach. Unlike the other monsters, it flew toward me like a streak of light. The gale raised by a single flap of its wings carried immense magical power.

hunks.baseline: As a flying monster that ranged through the sky as if it owned it, it was one of the most troublesome opponents in its own way.
hunks.sol: A flying monster that roamed the sky as though it owned it. In some ways, it was the most troublesome opponent of all.

hunks.baseline: *I don’t care.*
hunks.sol: *It doesn’t matter.*

hunks.baseline: Ignoring the Griffin leader rushing at me with its gale of magical power, I brought the spearhead down.
hunks.sol: I ignored the Griffin leader rushing at me behind its gale of magical power and brought the spearhead down.

hunks.baseline: Flames poured over the spearhead of White Flame, wiping out the gale of magical power rushing toward me and cleaving through space.
hunks.sol: Flames surged along White Flame’s spearhead, wiping out the gale rushing toward me and cleaving through space.

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk
preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: A fierce, razor-sharp slash, like a dragon’s claw, rained down toward the center of the densely packed monster army.
hunks.sol: A fierce, razor-sharp slash like a dragon’s claw descended on the center of the tightly packed monster army.

hunks.baseline: The heat and flash were so intense they seemed capable of melting everything before they even touched it.
hunks.sol: Heat and light flashed, hot enough to melt them before the strike even landed.

hunks.baseline: Hellfire engulfed hundreds—maybe a thousand—monsters and exploded.
hunks.sol: Hellfire engulfed hundreds—perhaps a thousand—monsters and exploded.

hunks.baseline: A rain of fire poured down. Screams and death flowed like lava.
hunks.sol: Fire rained down. Screams and death flowed like lava.

hunks.baseline: Neither the hides of the upper-level monsters—unmarked even by bullets—nor the quick-footed lower-level ones who sensed danger and tried to flee could escape it.
hunks.sol: The upper-level monsters’ hides, unmarked even by bullets, couldn’t protect them. Neither could the speed of the lower-level monsters that sensed danger and turned to flee.

hunks.baseline: Death was equal for all the monsters, and the leader of the Griffins watching the scene let out a roar like a scream.
hunks.sol: Death came for them all, and the Griffin leader watching the scene let out a roar like a scream.

hunks.baseline: I raised my head. The leader of the Griffins, already overhead, was shooting toward me.
hunks.sol: I looked up. The Griffin leader was already overhead, diving straight at me.

hunks.baseline: Even within its massive shadow, which blocked the sunlight, the monster’s beak shone like the sun, packed with immense magical power.
hunks.sol: Even in its enormous shadow, which blocked the sunlight, its beak shone like the sun, packed with immense magical power.

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: What if I met that attack head-on?
hunks.sol: If I met that attack head-on?

hunks.baseline: At the fork in the road I’d faced a moment ago, I’d chosen not to fight it, but to break up the monster army’s formation.
hunks.sol: At the choice I’d faced a moment ago, I’d decided to break the monster army’s formation instead of fighting it.

hunks.baseline: “I don’t have to be the one to do it. Right?”
hunks.sol: “I don’t have to be the one to fight you. Right?”

hunks.baseline: The eyes of the flying beast narrowed into vertical slits at the Demon Realm language that came through the System.
hunks.sol: At the Demon Realm language carried through the System, the flying beast’s pupils narrowed into vertical slits.

hunks.baseline: A brief hesitation in its final moment.
hunks.sol: A moment’s hesitation at the very end.

hunks.baseline: And the ones waiting for that very moment didn’t betray my faith in them.
hunks.sol: And those who had been waiting for that moment didn’t let me down.

hunks.baseline: The leader of the Griffins deflected something that flew up from the ground with a sharp crack, then staggered, unable to withstand the force.
hunks.sol: The Griffin leader knocked aside something that flew up from the ground with a sharp crack, then staggered under the force of the blow.

hunks.baseline: A bone spear.
hunks.sol: A spear made of bone.

hunks.baseline: As I watched it fall to the ground after serving its purpose, I thought of one person—or rather, one monster.
hunks.sol: As it fell to the ground, its job done, I thought of one person—or rather, one monster.

hunks.baseline: That bastard, who never got tired and was much slower than me, had finally made it all the way here.
hunks.sol: That bastard never got tired, yet he was so much slower than me. He’d finally made it here.

hunks.baseline: But the person I’d truly been counting on was someone else.
hunks.sol: But the person I’d really been counting on was someone else.

hunks.baseline: The air all around us shuddered. Everyone here, not just me, felt the battlefield’s atmosphere grow heavy.
hunks.sol: The air all around us shuddered. Everyone on the battlefield, not just me, felt it grow heavy.

hunks.baseline: I felt the wind die down in an instant, and the enormous mana rising from somewhere deep below press down on the battlefield.
hunks.sol: The wind died in an instant. From somewhere deep below, enormous mana rose and pressed down on the battlefield.

hunks.baseline: The leader and more than a hundred Griffins looked at one another in confusion.
hunks.sol: The leader and over a hundred Griffins looked at one another in confusion.

hunks.baseline: They were no longer flapping their wings.
hunks.sol: They were no longer beating their wings.

hunks.baseline: No—they’d been bound in midair by someone.
hunks.sol: No. Someone had bound them in midair.

hunks.baseline: The voice that followed was stripped of every trace of his usual cheer. It was bleak and subdued.
hunks.sol: The voice that followed held none of its usual cheer. It was bleak and subdued.

hunks.baseline: Mana seized the remaining flying monsters with precision and slammed them into the ground.
hunks.sol: Mana seized the remaining flying monsters with measured precision and slammed them into the ground.
As I listened to the Griffin leader cry out, a thought struck me.

hunks.baseline: Listening to the leader of the Griffins cry out, I found myself wondering what to call the sight of a massive flock of nearly a hundred Griffins plummeting toward the ground like streaks of light from hundreds of meters in the air.
hunks.sol: What did you call the sight of around a hundred massive Griffins plummeting from hundreds of meters up like streaks of light?

hunks.baseline: A spectacular sight? Or…
hunks.sol: A spectacular view? Or…

hunks.baseline: The Grand Mage who had staged this spectacular scene to close out the battle certainly deserved to be called the world’s greatest War Mage.
hunks.sol: The Grand Mage who’d staged this incredible end to the battle deserved to be called the world’s greatest War Mage.

hunks.baseline: The flames spread without end. Chaos took hold. Countless monsters were crushed beneath the Griffins’ huge bodies as they rained down like a meteor shower.
hunks.sol: Flames spread without end. Chaos took hold. Countless monsters were crushed beneath the Griffins’ huge bodies as they rained down like meteors.

hunks.baseline: Watching the monster army, its center completely broken, I shouted as I poured internal energy into my voice.
hunks.sol: I looked over the monster army, its center utterly broken, and shouted with internal energy behind my voice.

hunks.baseline: This battle was already won.
hunks.sol: We’d already won this battle.

hunks.baseline: A massive roar shook heaven and earth. The thousand spears and blades, still sharp, surged forward like a wave.
hunks.sol: A mighty roar shook heaven and earth. A thousand spears and blades, still sharp, surged forward like a wave.
